description: This is an abstract Java class named 'GenericMap' that implements the Map interface along with some custom behavior. It provides a foundational implementation for map-like data structures within the 'org.apache.ofbiz' framework, including thread-safe handling of key sets, entry sets, and values, as well as custom iteration and equality logic.
external_methods: atomic updater methods: newUpdater, compareAndSet, getAndIncrement

classes.name: GenericMap
classes.description: An abstract implementation of a Map with thread-safe and iteration support, serving as a base class for custom map implementations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getModCount
methods.description: Returns the current modification count of the map for concurrent modification detection.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the map if it is not empty, with reasonable thread safety.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if the value exists within the map.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on the map's entry set, key set, and values.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, specifically comparing map contents.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with the specified key, with optional access note.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the map's entries, lazily initialized with custom iterator support.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the map's keys, lazily initialized.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection view of the map's values, lazily initialized.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the entry for the specified key, updating mod count.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Copies all entries from another map into this map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the map.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Appends a string representation of the map to a StringBuilder.
